messages.subject: robots.txt on shinyapps.io
parts:
I tried to upload a robots.txt files on my (free) shinyapps.io site. It does not seem to work . When I look at the live robots.txt from the Google Search Console all I get is:  

User-agent: *
Disallow: /

This is not the file I uploaded and effectivly bans all bots from the site - meaning I will not be able to google my own site. 

Is there a policy on robots.txt and does it change with some of the paid options?

Does anyone have any advice on how I can change the file that is currently there (or even just see what is in my directory on shinyapps.io)?

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: robots.txt on shinyapps.io
parts:
robots.txt are not currently customizable.
We found that web crawlers would trigger sleeping applications to start, but not necessarily wait for them to load, nor make use of SockJS to interact with the application in order to render the contents, so there was no value being added.
Additionally, since robots.txt must exist at the top-level of the domain, i.e. myaccount.shinyapps.io/robots.txt, they would need to be configured at the account level, not per application.
We have on our backlog to see about supporting serving something static to the web crawlers so that applications can be indexed, but this is not currently scheduled work.
